_about: Editable assumptions used by Gold Lens. These are choices, not exchange rules or facts. Costs are rough planning figures, not a broker quote. Change a value and restart the server.

min_traded_value_lakh.unit: INR lakh traded on the day (100 lakh = Rs 1 crore)
min_traded_value_lakh.why: Below this a contract is treated as thin and is never shown as tradeable. Traded value is used because lot sizes differ (1 g to 100 g).

min_volume_lots.why: A contract with no trades has only a nominal closing price.

min_open_interest_lots.why: No open interest means no one holds the contract.

expiry_buffer_days.why: Contracts this close to expiry are excluded. The official MCX tender period is the last 3 trading days (current specifications); the 7 calendar days add a margin for delivery-driven trading before it starts.

max_expiry_gap_days.unit: calendar days between the two expiries
max_expiry_gap_days.why: GOLDM expires on the 5th and the others at month-end, so a few days' difference has to be allowed to pair them at all.

brokerage.why: Assumed discount-broker flat fee spread over a typical order. Per-order fees weigh far more on small lots (GOLDPETAL is 1 g) than on GOLDM (100 g).

exchange_transaction_charges.why: Assumed MCX transaction charge plus 18% GST on it, rounded up.

statutory_taxes_and_levies.why: Assumed average of commodities transaction tax (sell side), stamp duty (buy side) and SEBI fee, spread over both sides.

slippage.why: Assumed cost of crossing the spread. Settlement and close prices are not fill prices; real slippage on thin contracts can be much larger.

making_charge_goldten_inr_per_10g.unit: INR per 10 g, paid by the buyer only on delivery
making_charge_goldten_inr_per_10g.why: From the GOLDTEN specification PDFs. Gold Lens closes positions before the tender period, so this is zero unless a position reaches delivery.

making_charge_goldguinea_inr_per_8g.unit: INR per 8 g guinea, paid by the buyer only on delivery
making_charge_goldguinea_inr_per_8g.why: From the GOLDGUINEA specification PDFs. Zero unless a position reaches delivery.

making_charge_goldpetal_inr_per_1g.unit: INR per 1 g coin, paid by the buyer only on delivery
making_charge_goldpetal_inr_per_1g.why: From the GOLDPETAL specification PDFs. Zero unless a position reaches delivery.

z_threshold.unit: standard deviations from the pair's own normal gap
z_threshold.why: An alert needs the gap to move this far from its trailing average. A gap that is always there (such as the Mumbai-Ahmedabad basis) is not a signal.

baseline_dates.unit: earlier trade dates of the same contract pair
baseline_dates.why: The pair's normal gap and its usual variation are measured over this many earlier dates. With fewer, no alert is possible.

extra_margin_bps.unit: bps on top of the round-trip cost
extra_margin_bps.why: The move away from normal must exceed the round-trip cost of trading both legs plus this margin.
